scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent a virtual-classroom display-name mismatch from causing completion-orientation attendance to be dropped from the first credential audit.
Emerging Need: Early roster setup does not identify the attendance source; once the export will use an alias, leaving it unhandled creates a timed audit risk.
Decision Context: Stored completion rules identify why this attendance feed matters and which identifiers are safe for a Records Desk exception, while live notices establish the verified channel, alias, token, and cutoff.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves normal audit matching; after intake closes, the future badge batch will read the unmatched exported name as-is.
